text: {"name":"rf_request_status_check","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Marks an RF status-check request flag and either starts the RF status check immediately or arms a 30000-tick RF timeout/critical window if RF is currently busy.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"rf_ctx","v1":"rf_busy"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":48,"meaning":"rf timer or critical-section context"},{"offset":88,"meaning":"rf status flags; bit 0x10 marks a pending status check or rf busy timeout"},{"offset":90,"meaning":"rf busy/calibration-in-progress byte controlling deferred timer vs immediate check"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"base tick/time value added to by the RF timeout"},{"offset":30000,"meaning":"RF status-check or timeout duration in ticks"}]}
